title: HeavyTailedAdam.lean

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained differentiable objectives on R^d, permitting nonconvexity, with globally L-Lipschitz gradient and f(x0)-inf_x f(x) ≤ Δ. No minimizer attainment or convexity is required. L>0 and Δ≥0.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Each call at x returns g(x,ξ) using a fresh IID seed. The jointly measurable, integrable oracle is unbiased: E[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x). Neither function values nor paired evaluations using the same sample are provided.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedAdam.lean: spec.admissible, oracle answer and unbiasedness clauses; supplied LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every x, E[Σ_i |g_i(x,ξ)-∇_i f(x)|^α]≤σ^α, with 1<α≤2 and σ≥0. This bounds the summed coordinate central moments, implies E||g(x,ξ)-∇f(x)||_2^α≤σ^α without a dimension factor, and permits infinite variance when α<2. Independence between coordinates is not required.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedAdam.lean: spec.valid and the final two clauses of spec.admissible.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is R^d with its Euclidean norm, for public d∈ℕ.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedAdam.lean: Params.d and Params.x0; supplied LongTails/Algorithms/Adam.lean: Point.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: All parameters, including L, σ, α, Δ, ε and x0, are public. The objective and oracle distribution are hidden. Calls use IID seeds, and the extracted budget is a fixed cap counting individual oracle replies. The allowedAlgorithm field restricts admissible methods to the supplied Adam.method family; the literature comparison concerns the attainable rate, not implementation identity.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedAdam.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.admissible and spec.allowedAlgorithm; LongTails/Template.lean: execute and Convergence.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: The output must be measurable, its Euclidean gradient norm integrable, and E||∇f(output)||_2≤ε for ε>0. The criterion uses the first power of the norm, not its square.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Expectation is over both algorithm randomization and oracle seeds. No high-probability or almost-sure accuracy guarantee is required.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedAdam.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence, product probability law.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: An established smooth nonconvex stochastic-optimization benchmark with unbiased IID gradients, bounded central heavy-tail moments, and expected first-order stationarity. The coordinate moment bound is a conventional finite-dimensional noise condition.

descriptionHtml:
Adam with Heavy-Tailed Gradients

We consider stationarity for a differentiable, possibly nonconvex function f:Rd→R, where d≥0 is an integer. Its gradient is L-Lipschitz, with L>0, and a given starting point x0 satisfies f(x0)−infxf(x)≤Δ, with Δ≥0. The oracle returns unbiased stochastic gradients with independent, identically distributed samples and coordinatewise noise moments of order α∈(1,2] whose sum is bounded by σα, where σ≥0. We analyze Adam with a randomly selected iterate x¯; the goal is E∥∇f(x¯)∥≤ε, where ε>0 and expectation includes sampling and iterate selection.

The underlying optimization problem is infx∈Rdf(x), and ∥⋅∥ denotes the Euclidean norm. The algorithm receives d, the measurable sample space Ω, L, σ, α, Δ, ε, and x0∈Rd.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Smoothness and initial gap). The function f is differentiable everywhere, and for every x,y∈Rd, ∥∇f(x)−∇f(y)∥≤L∥x−y∥,f(x0)−f(x)≤Δ.

Assumption 2 (Heavy-tailed stochastic gradients). Let p be a probability measure on Ω. The oracle is a jointly measurable map g:Rd×Ω→Rd. For each x∈Rd, the map g(x,⋅) is Bochner integrable, and the scalar random variable ∑i=1d|gi(x,ξ)−∇if(x)|α is integrable for ξ∼p. They satisfy Eξ∼p[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x),Eξ∼p[∑i=1d|gi(x,ξ)−∇if(x)|α]≤σα. At call k, a query x∈Rd receives g(x,ξk). The measurable sample variables (ξk)k≥0 are mutually independent with common law p under their joint law Q, and are independent of the algorithm’s randomness.

Our result is algorithm-specific: we analyze Adam with constant parameters and without bias correction. The algorithm chooses 0≤β<1,0<ρ≤1,η>0,τ>0,n∈Z≥0, using the available inputs. Starting from the given x0 and m0=v0=0, it queries at xk and performs the coordinatewise updates gk=g(xk,ξk),mk+1=βmk+(1−β)gk,vik+1=(1−ρ)vik+ρ(gik)2,xik+1=xik−ηmik+1vik+1+τ,i=1,…,d. Independently of the samples, it draws J uniformly from {0,…,n}. Its saved output is initialized to x0 and replaced by the pre-update iterate xJ when call J is made. Thus, after B≥0 oracle calls, its output is x¯={xJ,J<B,x0,J≥B. In particular, with B=n+1 calls the output is the uniformly selected iterate xJ from x0,…,xn; the final call and update are included in this budget.

Let P be the joint law of the samples and the independent index J. The required output x¯ is measurable, ∥∇f(x¯)∥ is integrable under P, and the accuracy requirement is EP[∥∇f(x¯)∥]≤ε.

theorems.referencesHtml: • Florian Hübler, Ilyas Fatkhullin, Niao He. From Gradient Clipping to Normalization for Heavy Tailed SGD. 2024 (OPT workshop; AISTATS publication 2025). Complexity: O(1+ΔLε2[1+(6σε)α/(α−1)]) stochastic-gradient oracle calls, with fixed cost including initialization, for normalized SGD with momentum and a uniformly selected iterate satisfying E∥∇f(x)∥2≤ε.
theorems.formulaHtml: 1+⌈400000000⋅Δ⋅Lε2⋅(1000000000000+(100000⋅σε)αα−1)⌉+

import LongTails.Template
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2
import Mathlib.Probability.Distributions.Uniform
import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.MeasurableSpace

namespace OracleTemplate.Adam

abbrev Point (d : ℕ) := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)

structure State (d : ℕ) where
  selected : ℕ
  time : ℕ
  point : Point d
  momentum : Point d
  secondMoment : Point d
  saved : Point d

noncomputable def secondMomentStep {d : ℕ} (ρ : ℝ) (v g : Point d) : Point d :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 fun i => (1 - ρ) * v i + ρ * (g i) ^ 2

noncomputable def direction {d : ℕ} (τ : ℝ) (m v : Point d) : Point d :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 fun i => m i / (Real.sqrt (v i) + τ)

noncomputable def update {d : ℕ} (q ρ η τ : ℝ) (s : State d) (g : Point d) : State d :=
  let m := q • s.momentum + (1 - q) • g
  let v := secondMomentStep ρ s.secondMoment g
  { selected := s.selected
    time := s.time + 1
    point := s.point - η • direction τ m v
    momentum := m
    secondMoment := v
    saved := if s.time = s.selected then s.point else s.saved }

noncomputable def method {d : ℕ} (q ρ η τ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x0 : Point d) :
    Algorithm (Point d) (Point d) (Point d) where
  Seed := Fin (n + 1)
  law := ⟨(PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (n + 1))).toMeasure, inferInstance⟩
  State := State d
  initial k := ⟨k.val, 0, x0, 0, 0, x0⟩
  query s := (0, s.point)
  update := update q ρ η τ
  output s := s.saved

noncomputable def output {d : ℕ} (O : Oracle (Point d) (Point d))
    (q ρ η τ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x0 : Point d) (selected : Fin (n + 1))
    (ξ : (k : ℕ) → O.Seed k) : Point d :=
  execute O (method q ρ η τ n x0) (fun _ => n + 1) selected ξ

end OracleTemplate.Adam

open MeasureTheory

namespace LongTails.Setups.HeavyTailedAdam

open OracleTemplate

structure Params where
  d : ℕ
  Ω : Type
  [measurableΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  L : ℝ
  σ : ℝ
  α : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  x0 : Adam.Point d

attribute [instance] Params.measurableΩ

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance q := Adam.Point q.d → ℝ
  Query q := Adam.Point q.d
  Reply q := Adam.Point q.d
  Output q := Adam.Point q.d
  publicInput q := q
  valid q := 0 < q.L ∧ 0 ≤ q.σ ∧ 1 < q.α ∧ q.α ≤ 2 ∧ 0 ≤ q.Δ ∧ 0 < q.ε
  admissible q f O :=
    ∃ (g : Adam.Point q.d → q.Ω → Adam.Point q.d)
      (p : ProbabilityMeasure q.Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → q.Ω)),
      LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID
        (fun k (ξ : ℕ → q.Ω) => ξ k) (p : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
      O = { Seed := fun _ => q.Ω
            law := P
            answer := fun _ (_, x) ω => g x ω } ∧
      (∀ x, HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x) ∧
      (∀ x y, ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ q.L * ‖x - y‖) ∧
      (∀ x, f q.x0 - f x ≤ q.Δ) ∧
      Measurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧
      (∀ x, Integrable (g x) p) ∧
      (∀ x, ∫ ω, g x ω ∂p = gradient f x) ∧
      (∀ x, Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i, |(g x ω - gradient f x) i| ^ q.α) p) ∧
      (∀ x, ∫ ω, ∑ i, |(g x ω - gradient f x) i| ^ q.α ∂p ≤ q.σ ^ q.α)
  successful q f output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => ‖gradient f (output ω)‖) (P : Measure _) ∧
      ∫ ω, ‖gradient f (output ω)‖ ∂(P : Measure _) ≤ q.ε
  allowedAlgorithm q A :=
    ∃ (β ρ η τ : ℝ) (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ β ∧ β < 1 ∧ 0 < ρ ∧ ρ ≤ 1 ∧
      0 < η ∧ 0 < τ ∧ A = Adam.method β ρ η τ n q.x0

end LongTails.Setups.HeavyTailedAdam
